profile_text.body:
Ambarella Inc is a public company headquartered in Santa Clara, California, and trades under the ticker AMBA. Its website presents it as a maker of AI vision processors for edge applications, and the company says its advanced imaging solutions make cameras smarter by extracting data from high-resolution video streams. It names advanced driver assistance systems, smart electronic mirrors, drive recorders, and autonomous vehicles among the uses it addresses.

The site positions the company squarely in edge AI, where processing happens in the camera rather than in a data center, and it frames its work around automotive and video applications. The material available does not name individual products or customers, so the profile of its lineup stays at that level.

On the record-keeping side, the company is registered with the SEC under CIK 0001280263. No lawsuits are listed against it, and the only jurisdiction noted for law exposure is California.
